$comment: Menus link by page SLUG, never by URL: the importer resolves each to the page id it just created, because an absolute URL would still point at our dev site after install (theme-customer-base/inc/settings-contract.php, fm_nav_url()).
$sections: This design is a one-page site plus its policy, so the header's About, Treatments and Packages are in-page anchors rather than pages. They are written as `url` entries for that reason — when the customer grows into separate pages, each becomes a `page` entry instead.
